dm_single:
سلام! مرسی که کامنت گذاشتی 😊

7 پرامپت برای تمرین اسپیکینگ با حالت صوتی 👇
به ترتیب بفرست:

1. "Be my IELTS speaking examiner. Ask me Part 1 questions one at a time and wait for my answer."
2. "Give me a Part 2 cue card. Wait one minute, then tell me to start. Stop me after two minutes."
3. "Now ask me four Part 3 questions about the same topic, one by one."
4. "Give feedback on my answers under the four IELTS speaking criteria."
5. "List the three mistakes I repeated most, with the correct version."
6. "Give me five better words or phrases I could have used, with examples."
7. "Ask me the same question again so I can give a better answer."

ساختار رسمی آزمون: ielts.org/take-a-test/test-types/ielts-academic-test/ielts-academic-format-speaking
